title: PowerInfer: Fast Large Language Model Serving with a Consumer-grade GPU
technique: Exploit power-law neuron activation: hot neurons preloaded on GPU, cold on CPU; adaptive activation predictors, neuron-aware sparse operators, ILP neuron placement

optimized_metrics.evidence: In contrast to data-center deployments, which prioritize high throughput, local deployments focus on low latency in processing small batches.

exploiting the high locality ... hot-activated neurons are preloaded onto the GPU for fast access, while cold-activated neurons are computed on the CPU, thus significantly reducing GPU memory demands and CPU-GPU data transfers

[sparsity methods that induce sparsity] usually incur accuracy losses and wall-clock model acceleration challenges [34]. In contrast, PowerInfer uses natural sparse activations to maintain performance and efficiency.

headline_claim.text: PowerInfer significantly outperforms llama.cpp by up to 11.69× while retaining model accuracy across various LLMs (including OPT-175B) on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. For the OPT-30B model, PowerInfer achieves performance comparable to that of a high-end server-grade A100 GPU, reaching 82% of its token generation rate on a single consumer-grade RTX 4090 GPU.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we sample prompts from Alpaca and ChatGPT datasets, ranging from 8 to 128 tokens and measure the generation speed.
metric_definitions.notes: Defined only informally as end-to-end token generation speed (tokens/s) for a single sequence at batch size 1; includes prefill implicitly; never formally defined, no TTFT/TPOT split

metric_definitions.definition_quote: PowerInfer exhibits a highly consistent inter-token generation latency across different tasks, with only a 10% difference between the P95 latency and the average.
metric_definitions.notes: Only tail statistic reported; used to show consistency, not optimized

load_regime: batch=1 single-request local inference (plus a batch-size sweep)
tradeoff_acknowledged: Larger batch sizes reduce sparsity benefits so speedup shrinks (still avg 6.08x improvement at batch sizes tested); long input prompt with short output shows smaller gains (prefill dominated).
hardware: PC-High: RTX 4090 24GB; PC-Low: RTX 2080Ti; A100 for comparison
